API_TIMEOUT.title: API 5xx / 504 timeout
API_TIMEOUT.explanation: The simulated service timed out before confirming its operation.

prerequisites.RETRY: Idempotent service operation, fewer than three attempts, circuit permits request
prerequisites.CHECK_PAYMENT: Local payment ledger available; never initiates another debit
prerequisites.REFUND: Captured debit, no existing refund, explicit operator confirmation
prerequisites.CANCEL: No captured/unknown debit, explicit operator confirmation
prerequisites.OFFER_SUBSTITUTE: Verified equal-price grocery substitute; never medicines or infant formula; customer acceptance
prerequisites.CORRECT_ADDRESS: Explicit local lookup entry and customer acceptance
prerequisites.REASSIGN_STORE: Local simulated backup hub verifies same items; operator approval

API_TIMEOUT.approval_requirements: Numeric decision policy plus explicit restrictions. Store transfers need operator approval; financial cancellation/refund needs confirmation; changed goods/address/slot need customer acceptance. Manual incidents cannot use approve endpoint.
API_TIMEOUT.customer_message: Our delivery service is taking longer than expected. We are safely retrying.
API_TIMEOUT.escalation_path: Local operator queue; P1 after three failed recovery attempts; no external paging integration
